segments.sn35.60:1.4: Cakkhuñca paṭicca rūpe ca uppajjati cakkhuviññāṇaṃ. Tiṇṇaṃ saṅgati phasso.
segments.sn35.60:1.6: Evaṃ passaṃ, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako cakkhusmimpi nibbindati, rūpesupi nibbindati, cakkhuviññāṇepi nibbindati, cakkhusamphassepi nibbindati, vedanāyapi nibbindati.
segments.sn35.60:1.7: Nibbindaṃ virajjati; virāgā vimuccati; vimokkhā [vimokkhaṃ (ka.), vimokkha (syā. kaṃ.)]‘pariññātaṃ me upādānan’ti pajānāti.
segments.sn35.60:1.8: Sotañca paṭicca sadde ca uppajjati … ghānañca paṭicca gandhe ca … jivhañca paṭicca rase ca … kāyañca paṭicca phoṭṭhabbe ca … manañca paṭicca dhamme ca uppajjati manoviññāṇaṃ.
segments.sn35.60:1.14: Evaṃ passaṃ, bhikkhave, sutavā ariyasāvako manasmimpi nibbindati, dhammesupi nibbindati, manoviññāṇepi nibbindati, manosamphassepi nibbindati, vedanāyapi nibbindati.
segments.sn35.60:1.15: Nibbindaṃ virajjati; virāgā vimuccati; vimokkhā ‘pariññātaṃ me upādānan’ti pajānāti.
